[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.88) + 움직임의 신뢰도 하락.
· 현 구간 진단: 축적 구간. 방향성 확인을 위한 관망 조건 충족.

· Above SMA100($1.28)/SMA200($1.28). Mid-to-long-term trend remains strong.

· Bollinger Band current price position (near middle band($1.40)) + Bandwidth (21.95%) is moderate.

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase. Conditions met for wait-and-see pending directional confirmation.
